formal_attempt.failure_behavior: Complete and report both M1 and M2 unless an engineering blocker makes evidence incomplete; a scientific failure cannot truncate the remaining registered cells.
formal_attempt.resume: A durable create-only resume may finish missing registered cells after an infrastructure interruption without changing inputs, source, seeds, or gates; it is not a new scientific attempt.

hard_stop: After the validation report commit is pushed and its exact remote SHA is verified, stop for independent review and do not launch any prohibited follow-up.
input_scope: Only the complete frozen Gate1C regenerated-B0 private bundle and its exact nine B0 stage-best checkpoints; PMGC virtual-step outputs are excluded.
preregistration_binding: All formulas, seeds, mappings, gates, outputs, blockers, and isolation rules are exactly those in preregistration commit cd797d55362fd997beb6a9b7d5878aa790392831; authorization does not amend them.
